---
title: Column filters
---

By default each column gets the filter that suits its data: a slider for numbers, a checklist for text with few distinct values. Ask for other widgets by name, or switch a column's filter off with `FALSE`.

```{r}
library(lt)
lt(iris) |>
  lt_interactive(filter = list("auto", Species = FALSE), search = FALSE, pager = 5)

d = mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "hp", "wt", "gear")]
lt(d) |>
  lt_interactive(
    filter = list(TRUE, mpg = "range", cyl = "checklist", gear = "select"),
    search = FALSE, pager = 5
  )
```
